purpose: CDM (Character Detection Matching) parser-fidelity eval fixture for arXMCP textbook ingest path.

paper-control.description: Clean math.AG arxiv-paper-style formulas. Synthetic; project-original. Expected CDM near 1.0 for competent parsers.

hartshorne-style.description: Single-column dense math typesetting. Operator-hand-typed (no upstream copy).

griffiths-harris-style.description: Multi-column textbook typesetting (adversary F-M3 concern). Operator-hand-typed (no upstream copy).

milne-style.description: Course-notes-as-PDF rendered from .tex. Source: Milne's algebraic geometry notes (CC BY-NC).

notes: Per-page contract: NN-formula.tex (LaTeX fragment, no preamble) + NN-formula.mathml (canonical MathML ground truth).
Cold-start matrix: fixture <5 pages/class → tests skip; fixture 1-19 pages total → tests run but promotion gate blocked; fixture >=20 pages → promotion gate active.
Re-pin LaTeXML-derived MathML only when latexmlc binary version drifts; the .tex sources never need regeneration.
